{{Top|leg}}
According to the [[Gospel of the True Gods]], the three '''Gifts of the [[Yun'o|True Gods]]''' were bestowed upon the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the [[Before-Time]]. The Gifts of life, the least valuable gift, so that the Yuuzhan Vong could serve the True Gods; Pain, so that serving the True Gods was known to be the measure of life; and Death, which was the greatest gift of all, where one could experience the [[Blessed Release]] from the burden of Pain and the curse of Life.
